answer: 该结论不正确。RoG 中与 MetaQA 相关的是 MetaQA-3hop，原文明确说它“based on Wiki-Movies KGs”，而不是 Freebase [E1]。同样，RoG 在迁移实验中说明：从 Freebase 训练后“transfer from Freebase”再迁移到 Wiki-Movies KGs 上评测 MetaQA-3hop [E5]。因此 Freebase 在 RoG 里的角色是主实验的 background KG（用于 WebQSP/CWQ）及迁移训练的源 KG [E6, E5]，不是 MetaQA 测试所用的 KG。KG-GPT 方面，原文只说在 KGQA 中使用 MetaQA（1/2/3-hop），未在所给证据中写明其底层测试 KG 是 Freebase 还是 Wiki-Movies，因此 KG-GPT 的 MetaQA 测试 KG 证据不足，不能据此断言两者共同使用 Freebase [E7, E9]。训练样本角色上，RoG 从 MetaQA-3hop 的训练划分中选 1000 个样本，用于从零训练或基于 Freebase 模型继续微调 [E5]；这属于训练样本而非测试 KG 的证据。综上，“Freebase 是 KG-GPT 与 RoG 共同的 MetaQA 测试 KG”缺乏依据；可核对的是 RoG 的 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies，Freebase 用于训练/迁移源，KG-GPT 的 MetaQA 测试 KG 未在给定证据中说明 [E1, E5, E7, E9]。

A.6
IMPLEMENTATION SETTINGS
For RoG, we use LLaMA2-Chat-7B (Touvron et al., 2023) as the LLM backbone, which is instruc-
tion finetuned on the training split of WebQSP and CWQ as well as Freebase for 3 epochs. The
batch size is set to 4 and the learning rate is set to 2e-5. We use the cosine learning rate scheduler
policy with the warmup ratio set to 0.03. The training is conducted on 2 A100-80G GPUs for 38
hours. During inference, we first adopt the LLM to generate top-K relation paths with the highest
probability as the plans. Then, we adopt the Algorithm 1 to retrieve reasoning paths, which are fed
into the LLM to reason the final answers.
For LLM beelines, we use zero-shot prompting to conduct KGQA, which directly asks LLMs to
answer the question. For other baselines, we directly copy their results reported in UniKGQA (Jiang
et al., 2022) and DECAF (Yu et al., 2022a) for comparisons.
For combining the planning module of RoG with different LLMs, we use the planning module to
generate plans (relation paths), which are executed on KGs to retrieve the reasoning paths. The
retrieved paths are fed into different LLMs during inference by utilizing the reasoning prompts
template shown in Appendix A.10.

FACTKG

reasoning that represent the intrinsic characteris-

Multi-hop, and Negation. To further enhance its
practical use, FACTKG integrates claims in both
colloquial and written styles. Examples of claims
from FACTKG can be found in Appendix D.

MetaQA

PERFORMANCE WITH DIFFERENT TRAINING DATA
In our experiment, we finetune RoG jointly on the training set of both WebQSP and CWQ datasets to

UniKGQA (Jiang et al., 2022)) that are only trained on single dataset, we provide additional results
